notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.107

Customer payments: what was done in QuickBooks shows here (backlog 84)

What updates: for a customer payment already posted to QuickBooks and then applied or changed there (for example, its credit applied to a later invoice in Receive Payments), the app now shows:
the Applied to invoices lines;
any credit memos used;
Left as credit, as QuickBooks has it.
When it reads from QuickBooks:
when you open the payment’s page (it checks in the background and the page refreshes if anything changed);
when you click the new Read from QuickBooks button in the QuickBooks box;
with each sync, for payments from the last 90 days and any with credit left.
Credit memos: a credit memo applied to an invoice in QuickBooks is added to that invoice’s line (payment plus credit), the same way Record payment shows it.
Changed or deleted in QuickBooks: if QuickBooks has a different amount, or the payment was deleted there, the page says Check it in QuickBooks and why. In both cases the app keeps its own amount; a deleted payment also keeps its invoice lines.
Credit applied in the app: credit applied here but not yet sent to QuickBooks is left alone until it gets there.
Logging: each change goes in the audit log (“Applied to invoices … as in QuickBooks …”), and the sync log says how many payments were updated.
Database: moves to version 53.
